{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
df['revenue_numeric'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any non-numeric entries that were converted to NaN
nan_count = df['revenue_numeric'].isna().sum()

# Filter for completed orders and compute mean revenue
completed_df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']
mean_revenue = completed_df['revenue_numeric'].mean()

nan_count, mean_revenue"}
